episodes.rule: Never answer when the woods call your name.
episodes.title: Never Answer the Woods | Hollowmere Tales EP 1
episodes.summary: Odo and Mothwick carry the last flame through Hollowmere while something calls with his lost sister Wren's voice; they escape the Gloamhounds and riddle past the Wick-eaters. At the old stones the Pale Shepherd appears and wants the lantern, until a chapel bell nobody has rung in a hundred years drives him away.
episodes.cliffhanger: Wren's voice says the bell was her and asks Odo to come and find her in the chapel.

episodes.theme: True story: the Flannan Isles lighthouse keepers (Scotland, 1900)
episodes.rule: The records say what was found; the legends add what wasn't.
episodes.title: The Lighthouse Keepers Who Vanished | True Story | Hollowmere Tales EP 2
episodes.summary: In December 1900 the new lighthouse on Eilean Mor went dark; when the Hesperus arrived on 26 December, keepers Ducat, Marshall and McArthur were gone, lamps ready, clock stopped, one set of oilskins left behind. Superintendent Muirhead concluded a huge sea swept them away; no one was ever found, and the later 'meal on the table' details came from a 1912 poem.
episodes.cliffhanger: Moth: some true stories never end — the island kept their secret.
shorts: The lighthouse went dark. Three men were gone. 🕯️ #shorts

episodes.theme: True story: the Lost Colony of Roanoke (North Carolina, 1587-1590)
episodes.rule: If you must leave, carve where you went — and a cross if you're in danger.
episodes.title: The Colony That Vanished | True Story | Hollowmere Tales EP 3
episodes.summary: About 115 settlers landed on Roanoke Island in 1587; governor John White sailed home for supplies and war with Spain kept him away three years. On 18 August 1590, Virginia Dare's third birthday, he found the colony gone, 'CRO' on a tree and 'CROATOAN' on a palisade post with no cross, and a storm stopped him searching.
episodes.cliffhanger: Over a hundred people and a three-year-old girl, never seen again.
